plan.summary: FEAT-TFM-UI Dashboard editor: standalone `/settings/field-mapping` (LeadIntake pattern). 10-row tablo grid (cf1..cf10) — INMA Key | INMA Label (useDynamicFields hook via /api/v1/dynamic-fields) | Semantic | Type | Enum Values | Required | Action. plan.q_intent: P3 basla — FEAT-TFM-UI Dashboard editor. Pilot prep onceligi: Dent Adavista tenant 18173130 mapping girisi. Interview 8/8 Q-approved (standalone page + tablo grid + inline label kolonu + inline editable row + form-level save + hybrid validation + live reserved warn + '(INMA config edilmemis)' italic disabled row).

Q4 duplicate=hard block + 400 INV-BE-096. Q5 edit=inline editable row. Q6 save=form-level button. Q7 validation=hybrid (live duplicate + live reserved, diger on-save). Q8 empty-label='(INMA config edilmemis)' italic disabled row. AC1-AC8 gate Q onaylı.

aha_moments.aha_moment: Tenant admin 'Aha, cf4/cf5 INMA'da henuz aktif edilmemis, once oraya gidip aktiflemeliyim' diyerek mapping girmeden baska kanala yonlenir — 15dk debug yerine 1dk gercek problem tespit.

aha_moments.suggestion: FE bundle'da TenantFieldMappingReservedNames (23 kelime) constant, input degisiminde live check. Submit disabled + live warn.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Tenant 'name' yazar yazmaz input kirmizi + mesaj gelir, dogrudan farkli kelime ('musteri_adi') secer — 1 round-trip yerine anlik.

aha_moments.aha_moment: Tenant 5 mapping'i gezer, arka arkaya edit eder, sonda tek tik 'Kaydet' — network trafigi 1/10, UI snappy, atomik persist.
